test_perceptron_accuracy: test the Perceptron classifier accuracy on iris data with different input containers including sparse matrices
test_perceptron_correctness: test the Perceptron classifier coefficients match a manual implementation after fitting on binarized iris targets
test_undefined_methods: test the Perceptron classifier raises AttributeError when calling unsupported predict_proba and predict_log_proba methods
test_perceptron_l1_ratio: test the Perceptron classifier elasticnet penalty behavior with different l1_ratio values produces distinct coefficients
test_perceptron_with_custom_implementati: test a custom MyPerceptron implementation fits on iris data and compare its weights to sklearn Perceptron
